tests.title: Preview of a one to two hour item starts playing promptly
tests.goal: An editor can preview a long program item in Studio without the player hanging.
preconditions: At least one video item of 1 hour or longer exists (search Items sorted by Media Duration)
data: Item: the longest Online video item, found at runtime

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Open Search > Items and sort by Media Duration
Open the first video item whose duration is 01:00:00:00 or longer
Press Play/Pause in the item player
Wait 5 seconds and press Play/Pause again

expected.text: The item page shows the player within 5 seconds of opening the item
The player duration matches the Duration in the Overview (e.g. 02:15:36:11)
After pressing Play the time code advances within 3 seconds and keeps advancing (no frozen frame or endless spinner)
Pressing Play/Pause again stops the time code

notes: Longest Chinese item 20230222_財政司司長陳茂波宣讀財政預算案 (02:15:36:11): player showed duration 8136 s matching Overview, Play advanced the time code (09:51:31:20 -> 09:51:37:01 in 5 s), Play/Pause stopped it. Morning, off-peak.

tests.title: Chinese keyword search finds items with Chinese titles
tests.goal: Editors can find items by a Chinese word in the title.
preconditions: At least one item with Chinese characters in its title exists
data: Keyword: two Chinese characters taken from the title of an existing item at runtime (e.g. 財政 from 財政司司長陳茂波宣讀財政預算案)

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Type the keyword in the Search Items box and press Enter

expected.text: The results count is 1 or more
The item the keyword was taken from is in the results
Each result contains the keyword in its title or text

notes: 財政 returned 22 results incl. the budget speech item; 財政預算案 returned exactly that item; 中文字 returned 1 matching item.

tests.title: English keyword finds an item that only has a Chinese title
tests.goal: An English search finds the matching item whose title and metadata are only in Chinese.
preconditions: An item exists whose title is only Chinese, e.g. 財政司司長陳茂波宣讀財政預算案 (budget speech)
data: Keyword: budget (English for 財政預算案)

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Type budget in the Search Items box and press Enter

expected.text: The results include the item titled ...財政司司長陳茂波宣讀財政預算案...

notes: budget returned No search results found; 財政預算案 finds the item. Bug vs future feature pending Q-002, so no bug filed yet.
